description: Helper functions for parsing MEDIA tokens and media URLs from command or stdout text, including path validation, media extraction, and handling of fenced code blocks.

methods.name: normalizeMediaSource
methods.description: Converts 'file://' URLs to local paths by removing the scheme.

methods.name: cleanCandidate
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes and brackets from a raw media path candidate.

methods.name: hasTraversalOrHomeDirPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a path candidate starts with traversal or home directory indicators.

methods.name: looksLikeLocalFilePath
methods.description: Determines if a string resembles a local file path.

methods.name: isLikelyLocalPath
methods.description: Checks if a path candidate is a safe local path, rejecting traversal paths.

methods.name: isValidMedia
methods.description: Validates if a media URL/path is acceptable based on rules and options.

methods.name: unwrapQuoted
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string if present.

methods.name: mayContainFenceMarkers
methods.description: Detects presence of fenced code block markers in input.

methods.name: isInsideFence
methods.description: Checks if a character offset is within a fenced code block span.

methods.name: splitMediaFromOutput
methods.description: Extracts media URLs and cleans text from raw command/output text, handling MEDIA tokens and audio tags.
